name: Creeping Peeper
oracle_text: {T}: Add {U}. Spend this mana only to cast an enchantment spell, unlock a door, or turn a permanent face up.

rulings.comment: Mana produced by Creeping Peeper's activated ability can be used to pay morph or disguise costs when turning a face-down permanent face up or to pay costs associated with turning a manifested or cloaked permanent face up.
